# Coastal Ford Squamish

> Coastal Ford Squamish is a  dealership in Squamish. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory

- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/coastal-ford-squamish-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, index of all vehicles with VIN, year, make, model and price; full details are on each vehicle page

## When to use this source
- Use it to find vehicles currently listed by Coastal Ford Squamish (Squamish): year, make, model, price and a link to each vehicle page.
- Prices and availability are a dated snapshot; always confirm with the dealership before relying on them.
- Agent guide: [https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/coastal-ford-squamish-mirror/agents.md](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/coastal-ford-squamish-mirror/agents.md)
